question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'imaginary'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs an adjective to describe the noun *paradise* as created by an author in their book. 
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• plausible - (of an argument or statement) seeming reasonable or probable.
 
• imaginary - existing only in the imagination.
 
• drastic - likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect; radical and extreme.
 
• transparent - (of a material or article) allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen.
 
 
 
• From the above it is clear that imaginary is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

Complete passage__ - *The contract (1) __between__ the author and the reader is a game. And the game is one of the greatest inventions (2) __of__ Western civilisation: the game of telling stories, inventing characters and creating the (3) __imaginary__ paradise of the individual, from whence no one can be expelled (4) __because__, in a novel, no one owns the truth and everyone has the right to be (5) __heard__ and understood.*
